questions.text: You would live in the same home as the person you host, sharing daily life together. Where is that home located?

rules.reason: Home is in Maryland; Hope Found's Maryland provider application is pending
Home is in Virginia; host homes must be in DC
Home is outside the service area

questions.text: Can you read, write, and speak English fluently? You will need to read care plans, write daily notes, and speak with the person's support team.

rules.reason: Not fluent in reading, writing, and speaking English

questions.text: Do you have a private bedroom available for the person, with a door and a window?
When could the room be ready?

rules.reason: Room not ready for more than 45 days

questions.text: Are you willing to consent to a background check, fingerprinting, and a home study?
Do you have a stable source of income separate from this program?
Is every adult in your household willing to be screened?
Do you have experience supporting someone with a disability? (Not required.)

Daily life with the person may include routines that take longer than expected, or communication that looks different from what you're used to. Are you willing to adjust your own pace and expectations to fit someone else's needs?

rules.reason: May need additional readiness around adjusting to someone else's pace and communication style

questions.text: The person you host has the same right as any adult to make their own choices about their day, even when you might choose differently for them. Are you comfortable supporting someone in making their own choices?

rules.reason: May need additional readiness around respecting the person's independence and choices

questions.text: In a few sentences, tell us why you want to open your home.

consentText: I agree to be contacted by Hope Found, Inc. by phone, text, or email about the host-home program. I understand that if I am approved, I will be referred to as a Host-Parent and will be staff of Hope Found, Inc. Stipend payments I may receive as a Host-Parent are generally intended to qualify as difficulty-of-care payments excludable from federal gross income under Internal Revenue Code Section 131. Hope Found does not provide individual tax advice; please consult a tax professional about how this applies to your situation.
